mapper.update: UPDATE award_inventory SET state = IF(surplus_qty >= 0 AND surplus_qty = #{quantity} AND state = 0, 1, state), waiting_qty = waiting_qty + #{quantity}, surplus_qty = IF(surplus_qty < 0, surplus_qty, surplus_qty - #{quantity}), update_time = NOW() WHERE award_id = #{awardId} AND type = 'PHYSICAL' AND (surplus_qty < 0 OR surplus_qty >= #{quantity})

UPDATE award_inventory SET state = IF(surplus_qty >= 0 AND surplus_qty = #{quantity} AND state = 0, 1, state), issued_qty = issued_qty + #{quantity}, surplus_qty = IF(surplus_qty < 0, surplus_qty, surplus_qty - #{quantity}), update_time = NOW() WHERE award_id = #{awardId} AND type = 'VIRTUAL' AND (surplus_qty < 0 OR surplus_qty >= #{quantity})

UPDATE award_inventory SET waiting_qty = waiting_qty - #{quantity}, issued_qty = issued_qty + #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE award_id = #{awardId} AND type = 'PHYSICAL' AND waiting_qty >= #{quantity}

UPDATE award_inventory SET state = IF(state = 1, 0, state), surplus_qty = IF(surplus_qty < 0, surplus_qty, surplus_qty + #{quantity}), waiting_qty = waiting_qty - #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE award_id = #{awardId} AND type = 'PHYSICAL' AND waiting_qty >= #{quantity}

UPDATE award_inventory SET state = IF(state = 1, 0, state), surplus_qty = IF(surplus_qty < 0, surplus_qty, surplus_qty + #{quantity}), issued_qty = issued_qty - #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE award_id = #{awardId} AND type = 'VIRTUAL' AND issued_qty >= #{quantity}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO award_inventory (award_id, type, surplus_qty, waiting_qty, issued_qty, value_qty, state, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{awardId}, #{type}, #{surplusQty}, 0, 0, #{valueQty}, #{state}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE type = VALUES(type), surplus_qty = VALUES(surplus_qty), value_qty = VALUES(value_qty), state = VALUES(state), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, award_id, type, surplus_qty, waiting_qty, issued_qty, value_qty, state, create_time, update_time FROM award_inventory WHERE state = 0
SELECT id, award_id, type, surplus_qty, waiting_qty, issued_qty, value_qty, state, create_time, update_time FROM award_inventory WHERE award_id IN #{awardId}
